d: Short, voluminous honey-blonde hair is styled in a retro 1950s wave with a side part and a voluminous flip. The almond-shaped eyes are a pale icy blue with a confident, playful expression, set upon a face with the maturity of a young adult. A slender build is dressed in a red and navy blue plaid asymmetric cocktail dress with thin straps, paired with white opera gloves and sheer dark brown thigh-high stockings. Accessories include white-rimmed sunglasses perched on the head, red and blue dangling earrings, a thin black choker, dark teal pumps with bows, and a golden rose-topped walking cane.
